answer: In an agent economy, treat each identity as a vertex in a stake-weighted trust graph: new agents post a refundable bond and earn weight only as established peers attest to real work over many epochs. A fresh account is a blank ivory slab near zero influence, not an instant relic of standing. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount while one honest agent accrues trust cheaply.
